name: Gitea
summary: Sign in to gitea.com and other Gitea servers, clone from your account and organizations, and open links.

capabilities.reason: Talks to the Gitea servers you add to sign you in and list repositories.
Keeps your Gitea sign-ins in your system's secret store.
Opens your Gitea server in your browser to sign in.
Remembers the accounts you added and caches avatars.
Reads a variable that points it at a test server during development.
